column3: One person changed Naruto's whole life.
For years, almost no one in his village would look at him. Then his teacher, Iruka, stood up for him, and told him he was one of them.
Loneliness tells you nobody wants to hear from you. That thought is often wrong.
When researchers asked commuters to talk to a stranger, they had a nicer ride than people who sat alone.
So send one message today. Hey, I thought of you.
